mainEntity.name: Will Hometelligent Inc. remove my old range hood before installing a new one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, as part of our comprehensive service, Hometelligent Inc. will remove your old range hood before installing a new one. Our process clarity means this is a standard step included in the installation, allowing us to prepare the area thoroughly and correctly before mounting the new appliance.
